forecasts.claim: Claudia Sheinbaum wins the 2024 Mexican presidential election.
forecasts.p_text: It says 83% chance Claduia Sheinbaum wins ... I’m copying that over to Metaculus.
forecasts.source: INE official results of the 2024-06-02 Mexican general election

forecasts.claim: Boris Johnson is still UK prime minister at the end of 2022.
forecasts.p_text: Boris Johnson is still prime minister at the end of 2022: 60%.
forecasts.source: Johnson was replaced as PM by Liz Truss on 2022-09-06 (gov.uk, BBC)

forecasts.claim: Clashes between North and South Korea cause fatalities, or the North Korean government collapses, in 2012.
forecasts.source: No fatal inter-Korean clashes in 2012 and no North Korean collapse (news record 2012)

forecasts.claim: The Riemann Hypothesis is not proven in 2012.
forecasts.source: Clay Mathematics Institute Millennium Prize list: Riemann Hypothesis still unsolved

forecasts.claim: P versus NP is not resolved by the end of 2013.
forecasts.source: Clay Mathematics Institute Millennium Prize list: P vs NP still unsolved

forecasts.claim: General AI is not built by the end of 2013.
forecasts.source: No general AI existed at end of 2013

forecasts.claim: The relationship between P and BQP is not resolved in 2012.
forecasts.source: P vs BQP remains open (Complexity Zoo)

forecasts.claim: No classical integer-factoring algorithm with better asymptotic running time than the best current ones is found in 2012.
forecasts.source: General number field sieve remained the best known classical factoring algorithm

forecasts.claim: No one resolves in 2012 whether the integer complexity function is asymptotic to 3 log_3 n.
forecasts.source: The question remained open (integer complexity literature)

forecasts.claim: Humans have at least one functioning probe on the Martian surface or satellite around Mars throughout 2012.
forecasts.source: Mars Odyssey, Mars Express, MRO and Opportunity operated all of 2012 (NASA)

forecasts.claim: Russia loses at least one rocket launch in 2012.
forecasts.source: Proton-M/Briz-M failure on 2012-08-06 stranded Telkom-3 and Ekspress MD2

forecasts.claim: No contact with intelligent aliens is made in 2012.
forecasts.source: No contact was reported

forecasts.claim: The Hubble Space Telescope continues functioning through 2012.
forecasts.source: Hubble operated throughout 2012 (NASA/STScI)

forecasts.claim: HPMOR updates at least twice in 2012.
forecasts.source: hpmor.com chapter dates in 2012

forecasts.claim: The UK and EU extend the Brexit transition period beyond 2020.
forecasts.p_text:
UK, EU extend “transition” trade deal: 80%
Hold.
forecasts.source: The transition period ended 2020-12-31 with the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement; no extension was agreed

forecasts.claim: Kim Jong-Un is alive and in power at the end of 2020.
forecasts.p_text:
Kim Jong-Un alive and in power: 60%
Buy to 80%.
forecasts.source: Kim remained leader of North Korea through 2020 (KCNA, 8th Party Congress Jan 2021)

forecasts.claim: The Dow Jones Industrial Average is above 30,000 at the end of 2020.
forecasts.source: DJIA closed at 30,606.48 on 2020-12-31 (S&P Dow Jones Indices)

forecasts.claim: The Dow ends 2020 higher than its level around 1 May 2020 (about 24,300).
forecasts.p_text: I’m going to say more like 60%.

forecasts.claim: China is the second-biggest economy in 2020 (counting the EU as separate countries).
forecasts.source: IMF World Economic Outlook / World Bank 2020 nominal GDP: US, then China

forecasts.claim: A Pirate Party has been in government in at least one country for a time by 2020.
forecasts.source: The Czech Pirate Party first joined a government on 2021-12-17 (Fiala cabinet); none before 2021

forecasts.claim: Pirate Parties win at least 10 seats in the 2014 European Parliament election.
forecasts.source: 2014 European Parliament election: Pirate Parties won 3 seats (Sweden 2, Germany 1)

forecasts.claim: Pirate Parties win at most 30 seats in the 2014 European Parliament election.
forecasts.source: 2014 European Parliament election: Pirate Parties won 3 seats

forecasts.claim: The Conservatives win an overall majority at the next UK general election (2010).
forecasts.source: 2010 UK general election: Conservatives 306 seats, hung parliament

forecasts.claim: The next UK general election (2010) produces no overall majority.
forecasts.source: 2010 UK general election: hung parliament, Conservative-Liberal Democrat coalition
